mapper.update: UPDATE ck_shop_product p SET p.stock = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.stock), 0) FROM ck_shop_product_sku_combination c WHERE c.product_id = p.id AND c.del_flag = 0) WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ck_shop_product_sku_combination c2 WHERE c2.product_id = p.id AND c2.del_flag = 0)
